count_definitions.lean_declarations: in every .lean file under spec/lean/, after removing line comments (-- to end of line) and nested block comments (/- ... -/, including doc comments), the lines whose first word is theorem or lemma, optionally preceded by attributes @[...] and the modifiers private, protected, noncomputable, nonrec, partial or unsafe; reported as theorem and lemma separately and as their sum
count_definitions.lean_sorry_in_source: occurrences of the word sorry in every .lean file under spec/lean/ after removing comments and string literals
count_definitions.lean_axiom_declarations: lines whose first word is axiom, by the rule of lean_declarations
count_definitions.lean_audit_theorem_constants: N in the CI log line 'lean audit: N RCE theorems, standard axioms only': every constant of kind theorem in the kernel environment whose module is under RCE, including constants the elaborator generates (spec/lean/audit/Audit.lean)
count_definitions.checker_test_attributes: lines matching ^\s*#\[test\] in spec/checker/tests/**/*.rs and in spec/checker/src/**/*.rs, reported separately and summed
count_definitions.checker_tests_run: the sums over every 'test result:' line printed by the tests command: passed, failed, ignored, measured and filtered out, and the number of test targets (each 'Running' line and each 'Doc-tests' line)
count_definitions.spec_check: the lines of rce-spec-check as printed: LALR(1) rules, productions, states and conflicts per grammar; examples accepted by the grammar and by the checker; programs of spec/examples/reject, ill_typed and inadmissible whose diagnostic the check records; the three-parser lines in the tree-sitter build
count_definitions.grammar_conflicts: the conflicts figure of every LALR(1) line of rce-spec-check
count_definitions.examples: spec/examples/*.rce (top level); spec/examples/<directory>/**/*.rce for each directory other than reject, ill_typed and inadmissible (packages); spec/examples/reject/*.rce; spec/examples/ill_typed/*.rce; spec/examples/inadmissible/*.rce
count_definitions.canonical_json_vectors: the length of the array vectors in spec/data/canonical-json-vectors.json
count_definitions.emit_targets: the target names that rce emit dispatches to a program emitter in spec/checker/src/cli.rs; form (the Form JSON) is reported separately
count_definitions.wasm_checks: the checks of spec/wasm-test/test.mjs: those whose label begins with 'ts' are grammar checks (tree-sitter-rce.wasm), all others are checker checks (checker-wasm/pkg); passed and run for each, and the printed total
